codeReview.summary: The feature mostly implements stderr parity enforcement and documentation updates, but validator behavior is not actually schema-gated for stderr.diff artifacts, so v1 compatibility claimed by docs/tests is not met.

issues.description: TARGET_EXTENSIONS unconditionally requires '.stderr.diff', and artifact validation applies that list to all runs (line 273 loop), including schema_version=1 runs. This conflicts with the documented v1 compatibility claim that stderr requirements are only enforced for schema v2+, so docs/tooling are still misaligned.

The v1 compatibility test only asserts absence of 'stderr_match_recorded' errors and does not assert `vr.passed`; this allows missing '.stderr.diff' failures to slip through despite the test name/docstring claiming v1 should pass.

summary: Review failed due to a blocking contract mismatch: validate_outputs currently enforces stderr diff artifacts for all schemas, while the documented contract says stderr-specific enforcement is schema v2+ only.
